errors.evidence: The description omits one of the three lines shown in the chart. It describes "Търговия" (Trade) and "Износ" (Export), but fails to mention the "Внос" (Import) line, which is represented by a long-dashed line.
The line for "Търговия" (solid line) starts at approximately 59.5% in 2004, not 62.0%.

errors.text_span: достига пик от приблизително 68,0% през 2008 г.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies a peak for the "Търговия" line in 2008. In reality, 2008 is the lowest point (trough) for this line, at about 54.5%. The actual peak is in 2016 at approximately 66.0%.

errors.text_span: Най-ниската стойност на търговията се наблюдава през 2006 г. на около 54,0%, а най-високата стойност - през 2008 г.
errors.evidence: This statement is entirely incorrect. The lowest value for the "Търговия" (solid) line is in 2008 (approx. 54.5%), not 2006. The highest value is in 2016 (approx. 66.0%), not 2008. The description confuses the year of the lowest point with the highest point.

The chart contains two different dashed lines: "Внос" (Import - long dashes) and "Износ" (Export - short dashes). Describing the line for "износа" (Export) simply as a "прекъсната линия" (dashed line) is ambiguous because it doesn't distinguish it from the "Внос" line.

errors.text_span: достига пик от около 66,0% през 2017 г.
errors.evidence: The peak for the "Износ" (Export) line occurs in 2016 at approximately 65.8%, not in 2017. The value in 2017 is lower, around 63.2%.
The value for the "Износ" (Export) line in 2019 is approximately 63.2%, not 58.0%.
The opening sentence fails to mention that the chart also shows the share of imports ("внос"), thus providing an incomplete summary of the chart's purpose.
